stage6_execution_requirements_derived_fr: Use the current reviewed repository baseline for each registry; do not reuse Stage 5-era native primary counts as permanent constants.
Verify native production and Series production under each registry's strongest existing revision/content contract, not a weakened universal timestamp contract.

For HEI, MAG, SOG, CYA and AI use their exact build/hash facts; for API use exact data_revision; for BIR use exact regenerated content equality; for WLR use exact content/count identity plus only the weaker last_verified_at fact that actually exists.
Require the HEI central Stage 4 registry descriptor index to equal the accepted live descriptor set. A stale central snapshot is a failure, not an automatic refresh authorization.
Require Stage 5 relationship counts/sets to remain 21/17/1/0/44/161/0/0 and cross-registry relationships to remain zero.

Any missing endpoint, timeout, malformed JSON, identity/count mismatch, revision mismatch, weakened canonical-only/provenance fact, stale central descriptor or mixed-revision observation fails closed.
No production or vertical repository mutation is authorized by this audit. A fresh Stage 6 execution authority is required after this audit is reviewed and merged.
